dashboard.wellnessBalance: Here is your daily EthioPlate wellness balance.
dashboard.uploadPhoto: Upload a photo of your meal to get personalized Ethiopian nutrition insights.

recommendations.lowProtein: This meal is low in protein. Consider adding a boiled egg, lentils, or Kitfo to meet your protein needs.
recommendations.goodProtein: Great protein intake! This meal covers a strong portion of your daily protein target.
recommendations.lowIron: Your iron intake is low this meal. Add leafy greens like Gomen (collard greens) or pair with Vitamin C for better absorption.
recommendations.lowFiber: This meal needs more fiber. Add vegetables, lentils, or choose whole-grain Injera to improve digestion.
recommendations.lowVitA: Consider adding Vitamin A-rich foods like carrots, sweet potatoes, or dark leafy greens.
recommendations.lowVitC: Adding a tomato salad or fresh lemon juice would boost your Vitamin C and improve iron absorption.
recommendations.highFat: This meal is high in fats. If managing weight, consider lighter cooking methods or less Niter Kibbeh (spiced butter).
recommendations.highCarbLowProtein: This is a very carb-heavy meal with little protein. Add eggs, meat, or legumes to balance blood sugar.
recommendations.diabetesWarning: ⚕️ With diabetes, monitor carb-heavy meals. Pair carbs with protein and fiber to slow glucose release.
recommendations.anemiaWarning: ⚕️ For anemia management, prioritize iron-rich foods like Kitfo, Tire Siga, or teff-based Injera with Vitamin C.
recommendations.hypertensionWarning: ⚕️ With hypertension, reduce high-fat preparations. Choose grilled Tibs over fried, and limit added butter.
recommendations.cholesterolWarning: ⚕️ For cholesterol management, favor plant-based dishes like Shiro, Misir Wat, and Beyaynetu.
recommendations.weightLossGoal: 🎯 For weight loss, this meal is calorie-dense. Consider smaller portions or more vegetable-based dishes.
recommendations.muscleGoal: 🎯 For muscle building, aim for higher protein. Add grilled chicken, eggs, or extra lentils.
recommendations.energyGoal: 🎯 For sustained energy, include complex carbs like teff Injera or barley (Tihlo).
recommendations.wellBalanced: This is a well-balanced meal! Great job maintaining nutritional diversity.
